translit: Al-hamdu lillahi rabbi al-alamin wa sallallahu wa sallama wa baraka ala nabiyyina muhammadin wa ala alihi wa sahbihi ajmain rabbi ishrah li sadri wa yassir li amri wa-uhlul uqdatan min lisani yafqahu qawli allahumma allimna ma yanfauna wa-anfa'na bima allamtana wa zidna ilmaEn Meaning: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds, and may prayers, peace, and blessings be upon our Prophet Muhammad, and upon his family and all of his companions. "O my Lord! Open for me my chest, and ease for me my task, and untie the knot from my tongue, that they may understand my speech." O Allah, teach us that which benefits us, and benefit us with that which You have taught us, and increase us in knowledge.

text: [[insha'Allah|إن شاء الله]] tonight we will start with the biography of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, the [[Seerah|سيرة]] of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ.
And there are so many benefits in studying the life and the mission and the struggles of our beloved Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

And the fact that Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] sent him as a messenger for this [[Ummah|أمة]], and Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] chose to send a man, a human being, instead of an angel.
It shows that we are required to emulate him and to follow his example.

Because if Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] had sent an angel as a messenger instead, then the human beings would say, "Okay, these are angels, they're able to do what we are not able to do."
But because Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] sent a messenger, we are required to follow him and we have no excuse not to follow him. And his example is the best example.
Surely you have in the Messenger of Allah a good example for those who desire Allah and the Last Day and those who remember Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] often.
So by studying the [[Seerah|سيرة]], the life of the Prophet ﷺ, we learn how to follow in his footsteps.
By knowing how he lived his life, we know how to live our life.
And another benefit in studying the [[Seerah|سيرة]] of the Prophet ﷺ is that it is something that acts as such a boost to your [[Iman|إيمان]].
When you read about the Prophet ﷺ and the different incidents in his life, the way he received revelation, the way he dealt with people, the way that he struggled for this [[Ummah|أمة]].
Just reading about his life, it just increases you in love for him. Nobody can read the [[Seerah|سيرة]] of the Prophet ﷺ and not increase in their love and respect for him.

And this even goes for people who are not Muslims. Any non-Muslim who reads about the life of the Prophet ﷺ, [[wallahi|والله]] they will not be able to read it except with an increase of respect and honor for him that they hold in their hearts.
And this is something that is easily visible. Even the non-Muslims who study about the life of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, they have nothing but praise for him and respect for him.
So this is one of the great benefits of studying the [[Seerah|سيرة]] of the Prophet ﷺ, is that it increases our love for him. And loving the Prophet ﷺ is part of our [[Iman|إيمان]].

translit: La yu'minu ahadukum hatta akuna ahabba ilayhi min walidihi wa waladihi wa-nnasi ajmainen Meaning: None of you will have true, complete faith until he loves me more than he loves his father, his child, and all of mankind.

text: None of you will have true, complete [[Iman|إيمان]] until he loves me more than he loves his father and his child and all of mankind.
So studying the [[Seerah|سيرة]], studying the life of the Prophet ﷺ, is one guaranteed way to increase in your love for the Prophet ﷺ.
Another great benefit of studying the [[Seerah|سيرة]] of the Prophet ﷺ and studying his life is that it helps you to understand the Quran.

The Quran is the word of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] as was revealed to the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. But how do we see the Quran in practice? How do we see the Quran actually being implemented?
We see it through the character of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ. We see its implementation in the life of the Prophet ﷺ.
of the [[khuluq|خُلُق]] of the Prophet ‰. And then she answered them by saying "Don't you read the [[Quran|قُرْآن]]? Don't you read the [[Quran|قُرْآن]]?
Why do you need to ask me this question? If you read the [[Quran|قُرْآن]], you will know the answer to this question."

translit: Kana khuluquhu al-Quran.en: His character was the Quran.

text: His character was the [[Quran|قُرْآن]]. So if you want to see the actual practical implementation of the [[Quran|قُرْآن]] in someone's life,
then you look at the life of the one to whom it was revealed, the Prophet [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ‰.
Another thing is that there are some [[ayat|آيَات]] in the [[Quran|قُرْآن]] that you will not be able to fully understand
unless you know the situation or the time in the life of the Prophet ‰ that that [[ayah|آيَة]] was revealed.
For example, Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى]] says:

Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى]] revealed this [[ayah|آيَة]] to the Prophet ‰. [[innaka la tahdee man ahbabt|إِنَّكَ لَا تَهْدِي مَنْ أَحْبَبْتَ]], surely you do not guide whom you love.
Surely you cannot guide the one whom you love. [[wa lakinna Allaha yahdee man yashau|وَلَٰكِنَّ اللَّهَ يَهْدِي مَنْ يَشَاءُ]], but Allah guides whomever He wills.
This is an [[ayah|آيَة]] and what I just said is the translation of that [[ayah|آيَة]].
But to fully, really comprehend the gravity of this [[ayah|آيَة]], you have to know what the situation was when it was revealed.
The uncle of the Prophet [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ‰, [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]]. [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] defended his nephew, the Prophet ‰, he defended him from harm.
[[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]], he was one of the leaders of the [[Quraysh|قُرَيْش]], he was a very powerful man.
So when anyone wanted to harm the Prophet [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ‰ for his [[dawah|دَعْوَة]], [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] would be a shield in between that person and the Prophet ‰.
He would not let anyone touch his nephew, even though he didn't become a Muslim.
[[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] did not accept [[Islam|إِسْلَام]] because he didn't want it to be said about him that this person left the religion of his father and his grandfather.
He didn't want that to be said about him after he passed away. So he defended the Prophet ‰ and he helped him a lot throughout his period in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]].
From when the Prophet ‰ proclaimed his messengership in [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] up to the end of the [[Makkiyah|مَكِّيَّة]] period when [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] died.
[[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] was a great help to the Prophet ‰. So of course, the Prophet ‰ had this honor and had this love for his uncle.
First of all, he's his uncle, he's a blood relation, and secondly, he helped him so much.
Now when [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] was about to die, he was on his deathbed, the Prophet ‰ said to him, "O my uncle, say [[la ilaha illa Allah|لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّه]]."
"Say [[la ilaha illa Allah|لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّه]]. Just give me something that I can intercede with Allah on your behalf on [[Yawm al-Qiyamah|يَوْم الْقِيَامَة]]."
"Just say these words and I will intercede on your behalf with Allah on [[Yawm al-Qiyamah|يَوْم الْقِيَامَة]]. Just say [[la ilaha illa Allah|لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّه]]."
But [[Abu Jahl|أَبُو جَهْل]] and some of the other [[kuffar|كُفَّار]] of the [[Quraysh|قُرَيْش]] were also present at the time.
And they said, "O [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]], are you going to leave the religion of your father? Are you going to leave the religion of [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]]?"
And then [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] died and the last thing that he said was, "I die on the religion of [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]]," and he passed away.
So how do you think the Prophet ‰ felt about that? Of course, it was very saddening to him.
It really, really caused him a lot of pain to see his uncle die in such a way, on disbelief.
And then Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى]] revealed this [[ayah|آيَة]]: "Surely you do not guide whom you love, but Allah guides whom He wills."
Now think about it. If you just know this [[ayah|آيَة]] without knowing the story behind it, without knowing the incident from the Prophet's ‰ life behind it,
without knowing the relationship between [[Rasulullah|رَسُولُ اللَّهِ]] ‰ and his uncle [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]], if you don't know that whole backstory,
then you will not fully be able to comprehend the deepness of this [[ayah|آيَة]].
That's why it's important to study the [[Seerah|سِيرَة]] of the Prophet ‰, to study his life, to study his interactions with other people,
to study the different situations that happened in his lifetime. And only through this will you fully be able to understand the [[Quran|قُرْآن]].
So this is a very important benefit of [[Seerah|سِيرَة]] as well. And the [[ilm|عِلْم]], the knowledge of [[asbab al-nuzul|أَسْبَاب النُّزُول]],
the knowledge of the reasons for revelation, why were certain [[ayat|آيَات]] revealed.
